field.label: Enable AmneziaWG
field.help: Enable lifecycle management for all configured AmneziaWG client and server instances. Apply starts enabled instances and stops plugin-owned instances when the service is disabled.

field.label: Enable Watchdog
field.help: Automatically repair missing tunnels and restart a monitored client after three consecutive failed active health probes. Gateway Health Sync and health probes can remain active even when automatic restart is disabled.
